title: docs(permissions): state each read-audit degradation's real reporting granularity
body:
Fixes #19216
Clause-②: no

## What

`content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx`, section "Failure posture": the lead-in said **both** read-audit degradations are reported **once per process**. That was true of one and false of the other, measured on `origin/main` `502f179cc`:

| degradation | implementation (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/read-audit.ts`) | real granularity |
|---|---|---|
| buffer overflow | `:240` `let overflowReported = false;` (one boolean in the batcher closure; repeats go to `debug`) | once per process |
| failed ledger write | `:542` `const reportedReadAuditFailureCauses = new Set<string>();`, keyed by `auditFailureCauseKey('sys_audit_log', err)` (the error `code`, uncoded errors collapse to one bucket); docblock at `:499` says once per CAUSE | once per distinct cause |

The lead-in now says only what holds for both (neither is retried; each is reported once), and each bullet states its own granularity. The ledger-write bullet uses the same definition of "cause" as the sibling page `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/audit-service.mdx` (`recordAuthEvent`), so the two pages agree. The implementation matches its own docblock, so no code changed. Frontmatter and headings are untouched.

## Changeset

Docs-only. The one changed path is under `content/docs/**`, and no published package source or `files[]` entry is touched, so this is `skip-changeset` territory.

## Verification

Gates derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (change set from merge base `502f179cc`: 1 path). All **44** derived families ran on head `ceefc645` and every one exited 0, including `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:doc-anchors` and `pnpm check:nul-bytes`. Reconciliation with `--ran` (exit codes recorded): "44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Two gates first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3: `check:docs-transcript-drift`, which needs `@objectstack/lint` dist, and `spec check:skill-examples`, which needs `@objectstack/client-react` dist). After those closures were built under the verify lock, both were re-run and exited 0. The control-byte self-scan of the changed file found nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- "Once per process" for overflow means once per batcher instance, and `installReadAuditWriter` creates one batcher per install. In practice that is one per process, so the page keeps the wording the card accepted.
